item.title: Stablecoins Hit $28 Trillion: Core Infrastructure or Regulatory Trap?
item.description:
This week stablecoin transaction volume hit roughly $10 trillion in January alone — and the Federal Reserve just dropped an April 2026 analysis flagging three structural vulnerabilities in the ecosystem. Marcus sees unstoppable infrastructure momentum. James sees a regulatory cage match that could strip everything that makes stablecoins useful. They don't agree.
Timestamps: 00:00 — Cold Open 01:00 — Market Check 02:00 — Segment 1 07:00 — Segment 2 16:00 — Segment 3 19:00 — On Chain Watch

item.title: CLARITY Act Markup: Is This Bill Actually Worse Than Nothing?
item.description:
The CLARITY Act Senate markup is happening this week — and the crypto community is more divided than ever. Marcus sees a landmark regulatory win hiding behind messy politics. James sees a bank-lobbied compromise that could lock in the wrong rules for a decade. Bitcoin at $75,956, ETH at $2,339, and the legislation that could move both — today.
Timestamps: 00:00 — Cold Open 01:00 — Market Check 03:00 — Segment 1 10:00 — Segment 2 16:00 — Segment 3 20:00 — On Chain Watch
Sources cited in this episode: • Brad Garlinghouse revised CLARITY Act passage forecast April 13 2026 — shifted from 80% probability • Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong reversed opposition to CLARITY Act April 10 2026 — following Treasury S • White House Council of Economic Advisers 21-page analysis April 8 2026 — full stablecoin yield ban i • SEC Chair Paul Atkins and David Sacks coordinated endorsement statements — Senate Banking Committee • CLARITY Act passed House 294-134 bipartisan vote July 2025 — stalled in Senate Banking Committee ove
Next episode: If CLARITY passes, who actually enforces it — and does the CFTC have the budget to do it?

item.title: Deutsche Börse's $200M Kraken Bet: TradFi Signal or Overpriced Hype?
item.description:
Deutsche Börse just dropped $200 million for a 1.5% stake in Kraken — but here's the number nobody's talking about: that values Kraken at $13.3 billion, a 33% markdown from its $20 billion valuation just five months ago. Marcus sees the infrastructure play of the decade. James sees a minority stake with no control buying into a declining asset. With Bitcoin at $77,340 and crypto momentum building this week, we dig into what this deal actually means for your wallet.
Timestamps: 00:00 — Cold Open 01:00 — Market Check 03:00 — Segment 1 08:00 — Segment 2 17:00 — Segment 3 20:00 — On Chain Watch
Sources cited in this episode: • Deutsche Börse press release, April 2026 — $200M secondary stake in Payward Inc., 1.5% fully diluted • Kraken November 2025 funding round — $200M raise valuing Kraken at $20B, investors included Citadel • Deutsche Börse-Kraken December 2025 partnership announcement — strategic alliance to bridge TradFi a • Deutsche Börse Clearstream announcement, March 2025 — crypto custody and settlement services • 360X DLT Pilot Regime license — Deutsche Börse subsidiary enabling tokenized stock trading from Febr
Next episode: Kraken's IPO is filed but unlaunched. If Deutsche Börse just bought in at $13.3B — what does that tell us about the IPO price?

item.title: Tether's GENIUS Act Gamble: Compliant or Just Rebranded?
item.description:
The GENIUS Act is now law, the OCC dropped its supervisory framework in March 2026, and Tether just launched USA₮ — a federally regulated stablecoin issued through Anchorage Digital Bank. Marcus sees a first-mover signal in a $300B market. James sees a compliance costume on the same old Tether. Today: who's right?
Timestamps: 00:00 — Cold Open 01:00 — Market Check 03:00 — Segment 1 07:00 — Segment 2 17:00 — Segment 3 20:00 — On Chain Watch
Sources cited in this episode: • OCC Notice of Proposed Rulemaking, March 6 2026 — PPSI supervisory framework, two-business-day redem • GENIUS Act, enacted July 2025 — Bank Secrecy Act requirements for all stablecoin issuers, AML/CFT ma • Tether USA₮ launch, January 27-28 2026 — issued by Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., reserves custodied b • Senator Jack Reed (D-RI) — Foreign Stablecoin Transparency Act S.3907, Tether holds roughly 60% of $ • Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick Senate hearing — agreed Tether should be audited
Next episode: Circle just filed for its IPO. If USDC is the 'compliant' stablecoin — what does that valuation actually tell us?

item.title: CLARITY Act Vote: Regulatory Win or Bank Power Grab?
item.description:
The Senate Banking Committee is days away from a markup vote on the CLARITY Act — the most consequential crypto legislation in years. Marcus sees a structural green light for institutional adoption. James sees a bank-lobbying Trojan horse that bans the exact yield products consumers want. Bitcoin at $72,197, ETH at $2,219 — and the regulatory framework that could move both is about to be decided by 23 senators.
Timestamps: 00:00 — Cold Open 01:00 — Market Check 03:00 — Segment 1 08:00 — Segment 2 15:00 — Segment 3 19:00 — On Chain Watch
Sources cited in this episode: • Senator Bill Hagerty statement — CLARITY Act could enter Senate Banking Committee work period April • Senator Cynthia Lummis at DC Blockchain Summit — Senate Banking Committee markup scheduled second ha • Senator Bernie Moreno warning — if CLARITY Act not passed by May 2026, digital asset legislation wil • Senate Agriculture Committee vote — advanced CLARITY Act January 29, 2026 on 12-11 party-line vote, • Senate Banking Committee — postponed markup January 14, 2026 after Coinbase withdrew support and 100
Next episode: Crypto firms filed 11 OCC trust bank charter applications in 83 days. If the CLARITY Act stalls, is that the real endgame?

This week the SEC and CFTC dropped a joint classification framework naming 16 major cryptocurrencies — including ETH, SOL, XRP, and ADA — as digital commodities, not securities. Bitcoin at $68,226, ETH at $2,106 — and the real question is whether this changes anything at all.

item.title: Crypto's Next Cycle: Is AI Killing the Devs Who Fund It?
item.description:

James sees a hollowed-out builder pipeline that kills the next cycle before it starts. The data is real — the verdict is not.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs: $1.4B Reversal This Week — Is Smart Money Loading or Dumping?
item.description:
This week, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $1.4 billion in net inflows over five consecutive days — ending a five-week outflow streak. But here's the catch: Bitcoin barely moved.
